concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-wells-ic-braintree-marketplace-statements-reconciliation]] - collected IC+ Marketplace article for statement access and master/sub-merchant reconciliation; distinct from non-Marketplace or flat-pricing statement routes and not proof of current eligibility or deposit arrival.
warnings: The captured page is scoped to Braintree Marketplace and says non-Marketplace statements differ.
The fee treatment is explicitly IC+ and should not be transferred to a flat-pricing route.
The Braintree-hosted Wells IC path is not independent current bank-policy authority and does not establish current regional, account or pricing eligibility.
Statement and report amounts support reconciliation but do not independently prove deposit arrival.
